integrity: The proof combines an exhaustive stabilizer argument, the exact action on holomorphic differentials, and exact polynomial identities. Finite sampling is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the exact order-nine quartic \(y^3z=x(x^3-z^3)\) over \(\mathbf C\), not a varying Picard-family member.
The orbit profile is proved for bitangents, theta characteristics, Cayley octads, and Steiner complexes; other classical configurations are not classified.
An older classical or group-theoretic source may encode the same unlabeled cycle shapes under different terminology; no covering identification was found.
title: The order-nine Picard quartic has level-two orbit profile \(1+9+9+9,\ 9^4,\ 9^7\)
